_generator.name: hand-authored
_generator.comment: ARM template for the F1 Fantasy AGENT web frontend (Static Web App). Provisions a Free-tier SWA in westeurope with no GitHub repo linkage — the deployment token is fetched out-of-band (`az staticwebapp secrets list`) and pasted into the GH secret AZURE_STATIC_WEB_APPS_API_TOKEN. The hand-written GH workflow then uses Azure/static-web-apps-deploy@v1, which gives us full control over the build command (so VITE_AGENT_API_URL can be baked in per-environment) and matches the rest of the repo's deploy conventions.

metadata.description: Name of the Static Web App resource.
Azure region. SWA Free SKU is only available in this short list of regions; westeurope keeps it co-located with the rest of the resource group.
SKU tier. Free is sufficient for v1 (100 GB bandwidth/month, 0.5 GB storage, 100 staging environments — more than enough for PR previews).
Whether per-PR preview environments are enabled. We rely on this for PR test deploys, so it must stay Enabled.

resources.comments: Static Web App. No repositoryUrl/branch/repositoryToken — the GH workflow drives deploys directly via Azure/static-web-apps-deploy@v1 using the deployment token (apiKey) that this resource auto-generates.
resources.name: [parameters('staticWebAppName')]
